title: Rooster Horoscope 2027: What the Fire Goat Year Means for the Rooster
seo_title: Rooster Horoscope 2027: Chinese Zodiac Forecast for the Year of the Goat
description: How the Rooster is traditionally read in 2027, the Fire Goat year: the Rooster's relationship with the Goat, your element by birth year, love and work, the months to watch, and lucky colors and numbers.
lead: For the Rooster, 2027, the Fire Goat year, is a neutral year in tradition, with no special tie to the Goat. The Rooster's eye for detail suits a year that values care and craft. Here is how the Rooster is read in 2027, what your birth element adds, and the months to watch.
card_text: The Rooster in the 2027 Fire Goat year: love, work, your element by birth year and the months to watch.

sections.h2: The Rooster and the Goat year
paras: In the rules our calculators use, the Rooster has no traditional relationship with the Goat: it is neither in the Goat's triangle nor its opposite. A neutral year lets the Rooster's own standards set the tone.
The watch-out is criticism. In a gentle Goat year, how you point out a mistake matters as much as finding it, and a kind word goes further than a correct one.
after: 2027 is a Ding-wei year, according to the Hong Kong Observatory: Ding is a Fire stem and Wei is the Goat, so it is the year of the Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027 to 25 January 2028. These are cultural readings, not forecasts: no evidence shows a year's animal decides anyone's luck. Use them as a prompt to think about your own plans.

after: In the five-element cycles, as Wikipedia sets them out, Wood feeds Fire, Fire produces Earth, Fire melts (or refines) Metal, and Water dampens (or regulates) Fire. These links are a traditional way of describing how each element meets the year, not a prediction.

Born in January or early February? The zodiac year starts at Chinese New Year, so check the start date in the table; if you were born before it, you belong to the sign before the Rooster. Our born in January guide and the zodiac checker explain.

sections.h2: Love and relationships for the Rooster
paras: The Rooster's natural matches in our guide are the Ox and the Snake, its triangle partners, and the Dragon. In love, 2027 rewards appreciation: noticing what is right as readily as what is wrong. The Rabbit, the Rooster's opposite, is the pairing tradition marks as the hardest.

sections.h2: Work and money for the Rooster
paras: Our guide links the Rooster with accounting, journalism, quality control and public speaking, work where precision counts. A Goat year values craft, so careful, well-made work stands out. With money, the Rooster's attention to detail is a strength; the watch-out is spending on perfection where good enough will do.

Each zodiac year is also divided into twelve zodiac months. Each one starts at a solar term rather than at the new moon, beginning with the Tiger month at Spring Commences (Lichun) on 4 February 2027. sections.h2: Lucky colors, numbers and days for the Rooster
paras: In our Rooster guide, the Rooster's lucky colors are gold, brown, yellow, its lucky numbers are 5, 7, 8, and its lucky days are Thursday and Saturday. For the full profile, read the Year of the Rooster guide; for every sign in 2027, see the 2027 predictions.

faq: Is 2027 a good year for the Rooster?
In tradition it is a neutral year: the Rooster has no special relationship with the Goat, so the year is read as shaped more by your own choices.
What is the Rooster's clash month in 2027?
The Rabbit month, from 6 Mar to 4 Apr 2027. The Rabbit is the Rooster's opposite sign, and tradition marks its month as the one to take extra care in.
What element is my Rooster year?

It depends on the year you were born: 1945 is a Wood Rooster; 1957 is a Fire Rooster; 1969 is an Earth Rooster; 1981 is a Metal Rooster; 1993 is a Water Rooster; 2005 is a Wood Rooster; 2017 is a Fire Rooster.
What are the Rooster's lucky colors and numbers?
In our Rooster guide: colors gold, brown, yellow; numbers 5, 7, 8; days Thursday and Saturday.
